title: Certification: AI-103
why: A certificate won't replace projects, but it gets you past HR screens, and Azure appears in about 30% of UK AI engineer ads. AI-102 retired on 30 June 2026; AI-103 replaced it.
outcomes: Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Apps and Agents Developer Associate
Hands-on time with Azure AI Foundry, AI Search and agents
A badge for your CV and LinkedIn
lessons: Read the official AI-103 study guide and list every skill you haven't touched
Work through the Microsoft Learn paths linked from the study guide
Do the labs in your own Azure subscription: Foundry, agents, AI Search
Take the free official practice assessment; note weak domains
Revise weak domains until you score 80% or more on two practice runs
Book and sit the exam: £106 plus VAT, 120 minutes, pass mark 700
resources: Watch the spend; delete resources after labs
method: Book the exam date first: a fixed date stops it drifting. Study by weight, starting with generative AI and agents (30 to 35% of marks), then planning and managing a solution (25 to 30%).
build: Pass AI-103 and add the badge to your CV and LinkedIn.

quiz.e: AI-102 retired; AI-103 is now the Azure AI developer associate exam.

o: Implementing generative AI and agentic solutions
quiz.e: Generative AI and agents carry 30 to 35% of the marks.

o: A free online renewal assessment each year
quiz.e: Associate certifications renew through a free assessment on Microsoft Learn.

o: The official practice assessment plus labs in your own subscription
quiz.e: Practice under exam conditions and hands-on time cover both question styles.
